claims: Artemis I launched successfully on November 16, 2022, at 1:47 a.m. EST (06:47 UTC).
Artemis I launched from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis I launched from Launch Complex 39B.
Artemis I was an uncrewed flight test.
Artemis I used the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket to send the Orion spacecraft.
Artemis I was a 25-day mission around the Moon.
Artemis I concluded with a splashdown on December 11, 2022.
The mission goal of Artemis I was to test the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft for future human lunar missions.
Artemis I was a successful mission.
